name: The Medina (Place El Hedim)
tagline: Historic walled heart of old Meknes
description: The atmospheric old town centred on Place El Hedim, framed by the monumental Bab Mansour gate and a warren of souks, food stalls and craft workshops. Authentic, characterful and quieter than Fez, with cheap eats and history at every turn.
bestFor: Culture lovers and photographers wanting authentic medina life on a budget

name: Imperial City / Kasbah
description: The regal quarter south of the medina holding the Mausoleum of Moulay Ismail, the Heri es-Souani granaries and vast royal stables. Spacious, monumental and steeped in history, it is more about grandeur and sightseeing than dense residential life.
bestFor: History buffs staying near Meknes's grandest imperial landmarks and gardens

name: Ville Nouvelle (Hamria)
description: The French-built new town across the river, with wide avenues, modern cafes, restaurants, shops and the train station. The practical base for remote workers, offering better connectivity, more comfort and an easier daily rhythm than the old medina.
bestFor: Remote workers wanting modern cafes, comfort and reliable everyday amenities

name: Berrima
tagline: Quiet traditional quarter beside the medina
description: A traditional residential district near the medina and mellah, quieter and more local than the tourist core. It offers an everyday slice of Meknes life, with modest housing, neighbourhood shops and easy walking access to the main sights.
bestFor: Longer-stay nomads wanting a quiet, local base close to sights
